name: vince-gate
description: Contract-first implementation, test evidence and requirements-scoped review for coding agents, with read-only local project and task tools.

interface.longDescription: Contract-first development and a single requirements-scoped review. Bundled read-only local tools report plugin info, project context, task status and ledger structure. Requires Python 3.11+, Git and explicitly allowed workspace roots. Tools do not execute test commands or grant PASS.
